narrative.coaching_note: Siga haciendo higiene de manos antes de tocar a resident A para mantener protegida a esa persona. Usted tocó bed rail A con gloved hand a los 22 segundos y esa contaminación pasó a gloved hand en ese momento. Luego a los 26.3 segundos pasó de gloved hand a call button. Usted se puso los guantes a los 22 segundos y se los quitó a los 32.3 segundos, e hizo higiene de manos con bare hand a los 32.3 segundos con alcohol rub por 22.9 segundos. Después tocó a resident A con gloved hand de los 55.2 a los 63.6 segundos sin llevar contaminación a esa persona. Usted también hizo higiene a los 0.2 segundos y a los 64.1 segundos. Siga frotando por los 20 segundos completos cada vez que use alcohol rub.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A. Gloved hand contacted bed rail A at 22 seconds, transferring MRSA to gloved hand, then to call button at 26.3 seconds with two contaminated contacts. No resident exposures occurred for resident A despite gloved hand contact from 55.2 to 63.6 seconds. Hand hygiene compliance was 1/1 overall and 1/1 for Moment 1; Moments 2, 4, and 5 had no opportunities. Alcohol rub events at 0.2, 32.3, and 64.1 seconds were effective against MRSA and met WHO duration (21.8, 22.9, 24.2 seconds). No glove-use issues were noted, with donning at 22 and 54.8 seconds and doffing at 32.3 and 63.6 seconds. Disinfect call button and bed rail A with Use an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The clip showed no missed moments.
